help: Reshape: Move, add and delete a shape's points. To fix an outline. Double-click a point to switch corner and curve.
title: Reshape

help: Cut hole: Draw a closed shape inside a fill to cut it out. For the middle of an O, or a ring.
title: Cut hole

help: Knife: Drag a line across a shape to slice it in two. To split a shape and sew the parts in different colours.
title: Knife

help: Start point: Click the canvas to choose where sewing starts. To cut jumps by starting near the previous shape.
title: Start

help: End point: Click the canvas to choose where sewing ends. To finish near the next shape.
title: End

help: Angle: Turn the stitch direction with a dial on the canvas. For fills that should follow a shape.
title: Angle

help: Map to path: Repeats the selection along an open path. For stars or leaves along a line.
title: Map…

help: Outline or Fill: Switches a closed shape between an edge line and a solid fill. When a patch needs a border instead of a solid face.
title: Fill

help: Redwork: Adds a running outline along every edge of the selection. For a sketch look, or a border on many shapes.
title: Redwork

help: Lock: Locks the selection so it cannot move or change. When a shape is right and you do not want to nudge it.
title: Lock

help: Duplicate: Makes a copy of the selection. For pairs like left and right cuffs.
title: Duplicate

help: Delete: Removes the selection. When you no longer need a shape.
title: Delete

description: Help: what each shape action does
title: Help: what each shape action does

help: Show the design at its real size on this screen (⌘0)
title: Actual size

help: Select (S): Click to select, drag to move, drag empty space to box-select. For most editing. Shift adds to the selection.
title: Select

help: Pan (Space): Drag to move the view. When zoomed in. Hold Space to pan with any tool.
title: Pan

help: Measure (M): Drag between two points to read the distance. To check a crest against a hoop or a garment spot.
title: Measure

help: Open shape (1): Click to add points. Enter finishes. Double-click makes a curve point. For stems, borders and lines.
title: Open shape

help: Closed shape (2): Like Open shape, but the outline closes into a fill. For leaves, badge outlines and solid areas.
title: Closed shape

help: Circle (3): Drag a box for an ellipse. Hold Ctrl for a perfect circle. For round hat patches and dots.
title: Circle

help: Rectangle (4): Drag a box. Hold Ctrl for a square. For labels, bars and frames.
title: Rectangle

help: Pen (5): Draw freehand. Embroidery Studio smooths the line when you let go. For signatures and loose sketches.
title: Pen

help: Satin blocks (6): Click the left edge, then the right edge, and repeat along a column. For curved borders where you control each stitch angle.
title: Satin blocks

help: Text (T): Click where text goes, then type in the panel. For names, initials and monograms.
title: Text

help: Click to stitch (K): Click regions of a traced picture to stitch them. When you want to choose which parts get stitched.
title: Click to stitch

help: Manual stitch (7): Click to place each needle drop exactly. For small touch-ups.
title: Manual stitch
